title: application-exception public report v3
description: What an application discloses about one failure. message and as_json keep the meaning of the same corj fields; nothing else from the error appears.

occurrence_id.description: The occurrence id shared with the diagnostic report.

code.description: The application-owned code a consumer branches on.

as_json.description: Selected JSON details; null when the selection could not be serialized.

truncated.description: Present when message or as_json was cut to its limit.
